author: Halcyon Mytal, collector of curiosities
pages:
#Two Halves of a Mind

The Shivering Isles are divided as their master is divided. North lies Mania: mushrooms tall as towers, glowing caps, flowers in colours that have no names. It is beautiful, and everyone in it is a little too happy.

South lies Dementia: mire, fog, twisted black trees, eyes in the reeds. It is dreadful, and everyone in it is a little too watchful.

The city of New Sheoth sits on the hill between them, the Palace sits in the middle of the city, and the Prince sits in the middle of the Palace. Nobody knows which half of him is listening.

#Of the Inhabitants

Grummites are the fish-faced folk of the swamps. Their young, the baliwogs, live in the water and bite. Gnarls are walking trees, ancient and cross. The elytra are insects the size of hounds.

The flesh atronachs were made, not born. Ask no one by whom.

To leave, find the Fringe in the east, where the Door stands. It opens both ways. Usually.
